root.name: English Defense: Hartlaub Gambit Accepted
root.moves: 1. c4 e6 2. d4 b6 3. Nc3 Bb7 4. e4 f5 5. exf5 Nf6

overview: Black plays ...f5 to meet the white centre, and after exf5 has a pawn deficit but White's pieces are loose. White develops Bd3 and Nf3 and Black tries ...Bb4, ...Qh4 and ...Nf6 to exploit the light squares.

white_ideas.idea: Keep the extra pawn and develop safely with Bd3, Nf3

black_ideas.idea: Use the long diagonal and ...Bb4 for pressure

typical_structures.structure: White has a pawn on f5, Black has a b6 fianchetto

gambit.notes: White can keep the f5 pawn.

structure.notes: Open lines on the e-file and diagonals.

character.reason: Black gambits for a lead in development.

soundness.reason: Rare because White can keep the pawn.

plans.reason: Black aims at the centre with the b7 bishop.
